meta.universe: every UFC bout 2012-01-01..2025-12-31 (ufcstats) with at least one man at 0 prior UFC bouts; decisive bouts scored; 2026+ dropped at parse
meta.protocol: every choice by forward-chained CV 2019-2023 (fit on 2012..Y-1); stack gate forward-chained 2021-2023 with the 0.0005 rule; 2024-2025 scored once (holdout)
meta.production: coefficients below are refit on 2012-2025 by the CV-frozen procedure (deployment; never scored)

method.form: P(m | winner) = softmax_m(log base_m(division) + W[m,0] + z . W[m,1:]), z = (x - mu) / sd, DEC reference (0)

side_columns.elo: UFC walk-forward Elo / 100 (1500 for a debutant)
side_columns.lay: log(1 + days since last pro bout)
side_columns.wcmove: sign(this division's limit - previous UFC bout's limit); 0 for a debutant
side_columns.pre_*: tools/preufc.py side_pre on the pre-UFC Sherdog snapshot (only when the page is known at the bout: debutants and 2012+ debutants)
side_columns.short: 1 if a replacement with <= 21 days notice
side_columns.repl: 1 if replacement for a withdrawn fighter
side_columns.miss: 1 if missed weight at the official weigh-in
side_columns.g<h>_th/_sos/_sd: global network rating (logit units), decayed mean opponent rating, posterior sd
side_columns._n: prior UFC bouts (fades pre-UFC columns by exp(-n / tau))
